Subjects are research notes written before any analysis: **which problems are worth solving, and why**, and **how far public data can reach**. The notes are currently in **Korean** only. Analyses built on them are in [Reports](report.qmd).

| Subject | In short | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Pharmacy pain points (Korean) | Pharmacy problems sorted by the path a drug takes through a pharmacy: procuring, holding stock, dispensing, earning | Research done · 2 reports published |
| Patients taking medicines and supplements (Korean) | Problems of chronically ill patients who take medicines and health supplements together: choosing, checking against drugs, taking, monitoring; 20 public datasets rated | Research done · first analysis planned |
